claude.performance_metric: ~$51.4M net loss FY2020 (swing from ~$111.9M net income FY2019); $36.6M hotel impairment
claude.rationale: The slice documents a realized financial swing to a ~$51.4M net loss, a $36.6M COVID-driven hotel impairment, a $15.7M held-for-sale loss allowance, a portfolio wind-down (16 office properties held for sale, footprint reduced to 52 properties/~256 employees), and a corporate name change to Veris Residential. However, none of these lines describe any transaction or its post-deal integration; there is no evidence tying disruption to a product/process interface (p4) or to a process/organization interface (p5). Because the slice contains no information about an underlying deal or integration dynamics, both pathway determinations cannot be made and are coded uncertain.
